Aqrobat · October 10, 2026 · Integrated empirical Goal run

Three native constructions.
No exact payload recovery.

The intended result was readable, copyable native prose recovering https://example.com/ in at least two independent ordinary readers. The investigation produced reproducible negative evidence and stronger construction limits. It did not achieve that objective.

Finite investigation closed; native-prose objective unfinished.

No owner scan candidate is established. The final faint-text route was rejected for readability, and the fourth exploratory payload allowance stayed unused. All three rendered payload trials failed exact recovery in OpenCV, ZXing and jsQR. These finite results do not prove that readable native-prose QR is impossible.

Recorded start: 2026-10-10 21:24:22 UTC (5:24:22 p.m. Eastern). Absolute deadline: 2026-10-11 00:24:22 UTC (8:24:22 p.m. Eastern). Evidence/report seal timestamp: 2026-10-10T22:39:51.793810+00:00; elapsed to seal: 75.497 minutes.

RoadmapResultsActual imagesEvery batchReview and checksVersionsRemaining blockers

Roadmap status

  1. Native glyph/finder evidence

    Inverse native layouts: intended first-selected three locations/dimension57; every scored/true four-axis metric passes<=.291, but balance/span/stability fail strict gate.

  2. Readable exact-text layout

    Native sources pass exact paragraph and full-document Selection and source/font custody; dense foreground prose remains a worker visual assessment, not owner readability or portable-paste acceptance.

  3. Full payload construction

    Three payload-directed native sources rendered: two whole-glyph weight projections and one continuous black/gray foreground-text construction with visible Unicode ornaments. All exceeded ideal sampled-matrix correction limits.

  4. Independent exact recovery

    All three exploratory native payload trials returned no result in three ordinary readers. The amended conventional control for the latest trial recovered the exact URL in all three.

  5. Repeat and transfer

    16 of 17 immediate repeats matched PNG/RGBA; one mismatch stopped its batch and remains preserved. Transfer untested.

  6. Owner phone and print

    untested

No completion percentage, success probability, time-to-success estimate or novelty claim is supported. Local text selection, styled/plain transfer, native apps, phone and print are separate evidence lanes.

What the payload trials established

Source route Sampled matrix outcome Ordinary readers Strict native gate

V5 shorter prose projection 637 module mismatches; 108 function mismatches; 33 wrong codewords per block / radius 11; 203 of 656 quiet samples dark. 0 / 3 exact URL Failed
V2 continuous foreground prose + actual Unicode ornaments Literal: 203 module mismatches; 65 function mismatches; 41 of 44 wrong codewords / radius 11. Adaptive: 240 module mismatches / 68 function mismatches / 44 of 44 wrong codewords. Quiet: 0 of 464 dark in both. 0 / 3 exact URL Failed; first-selected dimensions 165 normal and 37 inverted, intended 25

Successful conventional controls recovered the exact URL independently. One repeat mismatch and one later invalid fractional-SVG control stopped their batches. A fresh single-path SVG control at unchanged geometry recovered in all three readers before the V2 native trial. The old failure remains preserved; the precise cause is a hypothesis because the drawing method changed.

Five of the nine full native captures received passive strict-gate profiling; all ten executed native branches failed. Four captures were unprofiled because their batch stopped or they were capture-only calibrations. No native source passed the gate.

The existing every-record strict native gate and thresholds were unchanged. Earlier O/o layouts gave intended first-selected finder locations and four-axis shape values within the isolated limit, but failed balance, span or stability. Those are partial measurements. A later selected location or source-aligned sample is never substituted for an ordinary first-selected result. Decoder recovery and strict eligibility remain independent outcomes.

Construction and mechanism batches

The first design lane operated only on retained source/sample maps and exact QR arithmetic. It made no captures or reader calls. Arbitrary post-terminator padding was explicitly noncanonical and used only as a construction hypothesis.

Design batch Denominator Outcome
measured-01 32 alternatives; 0 attempted, 32 unattempted Rejected quiet-field contract; original input retained.
measured-02 32 / 32 alternatives Canonical and explicit noncanonical affine constraints inconsistent; prefix-only bound excluded 31 and bounded greedy route exhausted one.
measured-03-closure 32 / 32 alternatives Fixed data plus fixed parity excludes every alternative in the measured model.
measured-04-v5 32 / 32 alternatives All exact systems inconsistent; immutable closure excludes every alternative.

Complete initial construction findings · Design scope and hashes

Continuous foreground mechanism

It used real installed-font characters, ordinary source words and visible native foreground styles. Unicode ornaments were explicit characters in the selected prose, not substituted alphabetic glyphs. The actual V2 layout did not realize its generous support model: line spacing and fractional word spacing drifted from the measured sampling phase. The later fixed-alpha bound excludes pure recoloring of that same retained layout within its declared literal model; it assumes unchanged native raster/blur coverage when foreground RGB changes, which was not separately measured. It does not exclude new geometry or ordinary-reader behavior.

Remaining blockers and a bounded future decision

The main unresolved requirement is enough independently controllable, visibly readable native ink to preserve function patterns and payload codewords at the reader's sampling points. Matching an isolated finder ratio is insufficient. The measured weight projections lack that control; the continuous foreground layout leaves gaps and adaptive-threshold contamination; the lightest tested repair loses readable words.

A future run would need a materially different, explicitly chosen native-ink construction with measured full-page coverage and readability before spending more payload trials. Repeating the same weight/color targets, loosening the strict gate, hiding QR modules, replacing characters with custom glyphs, or treating untested phone/print behavior as accepted would not resolve these results. No future phase, new allowance, automation, publication or sharing change begins from this report.

No owner phone/print scan handoff was earned. Portable plain-text and styled-text paste, native-app transfer, phone scans and physical printing remain untested. Exact browser Selection is useful local evidence, but it does not establish portable paste fidelity. Fast execution controls and billing savings were unverified.
